009/ FAQs

¿Tienes preguntas?

Everything you need to know before we talk.

Everything you need to know before we talk.

01/ What does NORTE actually do?

We’re a full-service AI agency. We find where AI creates value, build the automations, agents, and tools to capture it, then train your team to run them.

02/ How do I get started?

Book a free 30-minute discovery call. We’ll map a first opportunity and outline a clear next step.

03/ How long until we see results?

Most pilots are live and measurable within 2–4 weeks. We scope the first quick win before any long-term work.

04/ What if a pilot doesn’t work out?

We define success metrics upfront. If a pilot doesn’t hit them, we say so and stop — you’re never paying to keep a dead project alive.

05/ Do we need technical staff on our side?

No. We handle the technical work and train whoever you assign as the internal owner.

06/ Who owns the systems and data?

You do. Everything we build, plus the documentation, is yours to keep and run.

07/ What tools and models do you work with?

Whatever fits the job — we’re model- and tool-agnostic and integrate with the stack you already use.
